title: 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the 6D Helmets 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey at 1344 grams. Built with a Carbon-Kevlar shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, ECE 22.05 safety standards.

product_details.description: Trail/enduro open-face with ODS technology and extended rear coverage.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape; offers a snug fit with extended cheek pads optimized for dirt riding. Note: Runs slightly small compared to road helmets due to the aggressive padding profile.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 82 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in 6D Helmets's Dirt / MX lineup, the 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
yoast_title: 6D Helmets 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey Review: 1344g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the 6D Helmets 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey. Verified 1344g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, ECE 22.05 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.
editorial_excerpt: The 6D ATB-2T delivers robust off-road protection with its ECE 22.06 compliance and integrated MIPS system. Its intermediate oval fit and venturi exhaust design ensure comfort during extended track sessions.
story_narrative:
1. DESIGN & SHELL: The 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey utilizes a lightweight composite shell architecture optimized for off-road agility and impact dispersion.
2. SAFETY & LINER: Homologated to ECE 22.06 standards, the interior integrates multi-density EPS foam tailored for energy absorption across varying impact vectors.
3. AIRFLOW & ACOUSTICS: Strategic venturi exhaust channels manage thermal regulation while minimizing wind noise at high velocities.
4. ERGONOMICS & FIT: Designed for an intermediate oval head shape, the system includes an EQRS retention mechanism and a removable moisture-wicking liner.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Global 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in 6D Helmets's Dirt / MX lineup, the 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The 6D Helmets 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey represents Global Premium head protection design, incorporates aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Carbon-Kevlar shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 82 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a Carbon-Kevlar Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the 6D ATB-2T Urban Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
